name: 06890 · Southport, CT
findings: ZIP 06890 (Southport) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06890 (Southport) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06890 (Southport) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
